We're live at the opening of the new science center downtown, and kids are already lined up for the planetarium!
Tomorrow on the show, the curator of the transport museum tells us how they got a steam locomotive through the doors.

topic:Prison.text: Alcatraz ferry at 9:10 from Pier 33, bring a jacket, it's windy on the island
We did the night tour at Eastern State, those cellblocks are seriously creepy
The state corrections department announced that the 1890s penitentiary in Joliet will become a museum and visitor center.
Officials confirmed that Robben Island will open new guided walks led by former political prisoners.
Q: What was daily life like in Sing Sing? A: Silence was mandatory early on. Inmates worked in the quarries and ate without speaking.
Q: Why is Halden Prison in Norway famous? A: Cells have private bathrooms and windows; the focus is on rehabilitation.
Planning to visit a historic jail? Book the earliest tour; the cells are less crowded and the guides have more time for questions.
At Kilmainham Gaol tours sell out quickly in summer, so reserve online a week ahead.
Three Inmates Escape From Alcatraz in 1962. The men used spoons and papier-mâché heads to fool guards.
Old Melbourne Gaol Hosts Ned Kelly Exhibit. The bushranger's death mask is displayed in the cell block where he was hanged.
My grandfather was a guard at Leavenworth for thirty years; he said the hardest part was the night shifts in winter.
We visited the Hanoi Hilton, and the guide showed us the cell where John McCain was held. Everyone was quiet afterward.
Trivia: On which island was Nelson Mandela held for 18 years? Answer: Robben Island.
Trivia: Which Paris fortress was stormed on July 14, 1789? Answer: The Bastille.
Hey Carl, Eastern State Penitentiary has a Halloween event, and Al Capone's cell is on the tour. Spooky and educational.
Hi Mo, Port Arthur in Tasmania was beautiful and grim at the same time. The ruins are right by the water.
Opened in 1829, Eastern State introduced solitary confinement on a wide scale; this cell door shows the feeding hatch.
The Tower of London served as a jail for centuries; Rudolf Hess was one of the last people held here, in 1941.
Breaking on the morning show: two men walked out of the county lockup overnight and police are searching the river woods.
Our guest today served twelve years in Angola, Louisiana, and now runs the rodeo program for the inmates there.

topic:Restaurant.text: Got a table at Noma for 8! Wear something nice, the tasting menu is like 20 courses
Katz's Deli, pastrami on rye, the line moves fast. Meet me at the corner
Chef Massimo Bottura announced today that Osteria Francescana will open a second dining room for lunch service.
The Ledbury confirmed it has regained its third Michelin star after reopening in Notting Hill last year.
Q: What's the signature dish at El Celler de Can Roca? A: Probably the caramelized olives on a little bonsai tree.
Q: Why open a ramen bar in a basement? A: Rent was cheap, and people like finding a hidden place.
Reserve popular bistros at 10 a.m. thirty days ahead, when many booking systems release new tables.
Ask your server what the kitchen is proudest of tonight; it's usually better than the bestseller.
Beloved Diner Closes After 70 Years. Lou's on Main Street served its last cup of coffee to a line around the block.
Taqueria Wins Michelin Star. El Califa de León in Mexico City is the first street taco stand to receive the honor.
We stumbled into a tiny trattoria in Rome with no menu; the nonna just brought us whatever she'd cooked. Best meal of my life.
My first job was washing dishes at Antoine's in New Orleans, and the chef let me taste the oysters Rockefeller.
Trivia: Which New Orleans eatery invented Oysters Rockefeller in 1899? Answer: Antoine's.
Trivia: Which Danish place was named world's best four times and pioneered New Nordic cuisine? Answer: Noma.
Hey Gina, the dumpling place in Flushing is open again. Soup dumplings for twelve bucks. Saturday lunch?
Hi Omar, the steakhouse in Buenos Aires we went to, La Cabrera, still has the best grilled provoleta. Let's go back.
Founded in 1725, Sobrino de Botín in Madrid is said to be the oldest operating restaurant in the world.
This menu from Delmonico's, 1899, lists terrapin, canvasback duck and the original Baked Alaska.
Food hour, folks! Today we're at a smoky barbecue joint in Austin where the brisket line starts at six a.m.
Caller says the new pho spot on Elm Street is the best in town, and the owner just texted us: free spring rolls for listeners!

topic:ShoppingMall.text: Meet at the food court in the Galleria, by the escalator near Zara
Mall of America has an indoor roller coaster??? we're going this weekend
Westfield announced today that its London center at Stratford will add 40 new stores and a rooftop cinema.
The Dubai Mall confirmed a new aquarium tunnel and a second ice rink as part of its expansion.
Q: What's the secret of the King of Prussia mall's success? A: Location near Philadelphia and a huge mix of luxury and everyday brands.
Q: Why did you turn the old department store into a climbing gym? A: Anchor stores are leaving; people now come for experiences.
Going to a big shopping center on Black Friday? Park near the cinema entrance; it's usually the emptiest lot.
Use the directory kiosks or app map; big malls like West Edmonton have over 800 stores.
Dead Mall Reborn as Medical Center. The 1970s Hickory Hollow complex in Nashville now houses clinics and a library.
Southdale Turns 70. America's first enclosed mall, in Edina, Minnesota, celebrates with a vintage car show.
In the nineties my friends and I spent every Saturday at the Galleria, just walking loops and eating pretzels.
I got lost in the Iran Mall in Tehran for two hours. It has a library, a lake and a mirrored palace hall.
Trivia: Which Alberta shopping center was once the largest in the world and has a wave pool? Answer: West Edmonton Mall.
Trivia: What was the name of the first fully enclosed US mall, opened in 1956? Answer: Southdale Center.
Hey Becca, Garden State Plaza has a big sale this weekend. Let's grab lunch at the food court after.
Hi Ken, the Siam Paragon in Bangkok is wild. Car showrooms on one floor and an aquarium below.
The Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II in Milan, opened in 1877, is one of the world's oldest covered shopping arcades.
This neon sign hung above the entrance of the Northland Center in Michigan, a pioneering open-air mall from 1954.
Live from the new outlet center out on Route 9, and they're giving away gift cards to the first hundred shoppers!
Traffic update: the parking garage at Tysons Corner is full, use the Metro stop instead.

topic:Galaxy.text: Clear skies tonight! You can see Andromeda with binoculars, look near Cassiopeia
Did you see the new Webb image of the Cartwheel? Those spiral arms look like a wheel
NASA released a new image today of the Pinwheel Galaxy, M101, showing young star clusters across its spiral arms.
Astronomers announced the discovery of JADES-GS-z14-0, a galaxy seen just 290 million years after the Big Bang.
Q: How far is Andromeda? A: About 2.5 million light-years. The light you see left it before humans existed.
Q: Why is the Sombrero so recognizable? A: A bright bulge and a dark dust lane make it look like a wide-brimmed hat.
To find Andromeda, go to the Great Square of Pegasus, then hop two stars up toward Cassiopeia.
For photographing the Whirlpool, use a tracking mount and stack many short exposures to bring out the arms.
Milky Way and Andromeda Collision May Be Less Likely. New measurements cut the chance of a merger in ten billion years to about half.
Webb Spots 'Phoenix' Spiral Rebuilding Itself. The dwarf system appears to be forming new stars from recycled gas.
I was camping in the Atacama when my guide pointed up and said, that's the Large Magellanic Cloud. It looked like a ghost.
First time I saw the Milky Way's core from a dark sky, I actually cried. It looks like smoke across the sky.
Trivia: Which spiral is the nearest large neighbor of the Milky Way? Answer: Andromeda, M31.
Trivia: Which two irregular companions of our galaxy are visible from the Southern Hemisphere? Answer: The Large and Small Magellanic Clouds.
Hey Ravi, finally got a photo of M51 with my telescope. The companion is visible too, a little smudge.
Hi Sara, the planetarium show on the Triangulum spiral was so cool, it has about 40 billion stars.
Centaurus A, an elliptical with a twisted dust lane, hosts a supermassive black hole firing jets a million light-years long.
This photographic plate, taken by Edwin Hubble in 1923, showed a variable star in Andromeda and proved it lay far beyond our own.
Tonight on Sky Talk: why the Cigar, M82, is bursting with new stars after a close pass by its neighbor M81.
Listener question: can you see a whole galaxy with your naked eye? Yes, Andromeda, on a dark autumn night!

topic:Planet.text: Look west after sunset, that bright 'star' is Venus! Brightest thing in the sky tonight
Jupiter's moons are visible through my little telescope, four tiny dots in a line!
NASA announced today that Perseverance found new organic molecules in rocks from Jezero Crater on Mars.
Astronomers announced that TRAPPIST-1e may hold liquid water, according to new Webb observations.
Q: Why is Venus so hot? A: Its thick carbon dioxide atmosphere traps heat; the surface is about 465 °C.
Q: How long is a day on Mercury? A: One solar day lasts about 176 Earth days, longer than its year.
To spot Saturn's rings, use a telescope with at least 25x magnification and look in a dark, steady sky.
Use a stargazing app to locate Mars; it shines with a reddish color that doesn't twinkle.
Uranus Spins on Its Side, New Model Explains Why. A giant collision billions of years ago likely tipped it over.
Neptune's Winds Clocked at 2,100 km/h. Voyager data reveals the fastest winds measured in the solar system.
My grandpa set up his telescope on the back porch and showed me Saturn's rings. I didn't believe it was real.
In third grade I made a papier-mâché Jupiter with a red spot. My teacher hung it from the classroom ceiling.
Trivia: Which world in our solar system has the Great Red Spot? Answer: Jupiter.
Trivia: What was the first planet discovered with a telescope, in 1781? Answer: Uranus, by William Herschel.
Hey Maya, Mars and Venus are close together in the sky this week. Look west around 9pm!
Hi Leo, we watched the Cassini documentary. Did you know Saturn could float in a giant bathtub?
Mars has the tallest volcano in the solar system, Olympus Mons, about 22 kilometers high.
This meteorite was blasted off the Martian surface and landed in Egypt in 1911.
Tonight on Space Hour: the planet where it rains diamonds. That's right, deep inside Neptune!
Callers, look south tonight around ten; Saturn is at opposition, the best view of the year!

topic:Diocese.text: Bishop's visiting our parish Sunday for confirmations, the whole chancery from Brooklyn is coming
Did you get the bishop's letter? New Mass times for all churches in the deanery
The Diocese of Arlington announced today that Bishop Michael Burbidge will ordain six new priests at the Cathedral of St. Thomas More.
The Anglican Diocese of Sydney confirmed that its synod will meet in October to elect a new archbishop.
Q: How many parishes does Chicago's archbishop oversee? A: Over 200, serving about two million Catholics.
Q: What does a bishop do in a see like Durham? A: He oversees the clergy, confirms people and cares for the cathedral.
If you're moving to Westminster, check the cardinal's archdiocesan website to find the parish that covers your address.
To arrange a church wedding, start with your parish priest; the diocese may require a marriage preparation course.
Archdiocese of Los Angeles Opens New Cathedral Center. The Cathedral of Our Lady of the Angels hosts the dedication Mass.
Lincoln Bishop Merges Rural Parishes. Fewer priests have prompted the Nebraska see to combine twelve churches.
When I was an altar boy in the Diocese of Cork, the bishop came to bless our new bell, and I nearly dropped the incense.
My aunt worked forty years in the chancery office of the Archdiocese of Boston, filing baptism records.
Trivia: Which see does the Pope lead as its bishop? Answer: Rome.
Trivia: Which English see is the oldest, founded by Augustine in 597? Answer: Canterbury.
Hey Father Tom, the youth group from the bishopric of Galway is joining us for the pilgrimage in July.
Hi Anne, the bishop of Lyon sent a lovely letter for our parish's 200th anniversary. I'll forward it.
Founded in 1789, the Diocese of Baltimore was the first Catholic diocese in the United States.
This map shows the boundaries of the medieval see of Lincoln, once stretching from the Humber to the Thames.
Today on Faith Matters, the archbishop talks about plans to restore churches across the province.
Morning show: the diocese is hosting a charity run for the Catholic schools. Sign up online!

topic:Airport.text: Landed at Heathrow T5, passport queue is massive, I'll text when I'm at arrivals
Flight delayed at O'Hare again, snow on the runway. Don't wait up
Changi Airport announced today that its Terminal 5 will open in 2030, adding capacity for 50 million passengers a year.
Denver International confirmed that a new concourse with 26 gates opened this morning on its east side.
Q: Why is the approach into Paro in Bhutan so tricky? A: You fly between mountains and only see the runway at the last moment.
Q: What makes Hartsfield-Jackson in Atlanta so busy? A: It's a huge Delta hub, and most of the US is within a two-hour flight.
Arriving at JFK? The AirTrain to Jamaica station plus the subway is much cheaper than a taxi into Manhattan.
At Schiphol, allow extra time for security; the queues for non-Schengen flights can take an hour in summer.
Kai Tak Closes After 73 Years. Hong Kong's famous harbor airfield, with its steep turn over rooftops, shut down overnight.
New Istanbul Airport Becomes Europe's Busiest. The hub overtook London Heathrow in passenger numbers last year.
I got stuck overnight at Reykjavík's Keflavík during a storm and slept under a bench next to a choir from Norway.
My dad worked baggage at LaGuardia for thirty years and he still judges every suitcase he sees.
Trivia: Which hub has a butterfly garden, a waterfall called the Rain Vortex and a rooftop pool? Answer: Singapore Changi.
Trivia: Which airfield in Saint Martin is famous for planes landing just above a beach? Answer: Princess Juliana International.
Hey Ash, pick me up at Gatwick North Terminal at 6, I'll be by the coffee shop near arrivals.
Hi Lena, Munich's terminal has its own brewery! I had a beer and a pretzel during my layover.
Tempelhof in Berlin served as the lifeline of the 1948 Berlin Airlift, with planes landing every 90 seconds.
This control tower radio was used at Croydon, London's first international airport, opened in 1920.
Traffic and travel: heavy delays at LAX this morning, allow two hours for security at Terminal 4.
Good news for travelers, the new parking garage at Logan opens today, and the first day is free!

topic:Dam.text: Hoover Dam tour is sold out at noon, we got the 2pm one, meet at the visitor center
Did you see the spillway at Oroville on the news? Water's pouring over everything
The Bureau of Reclamation announced that Glen Canyon Dam will release extra water this spring to rebuild sandbars in the Grand Canyon.
China Three Gorges Corporation confirmed record electricity output from the Yangtze facility last year.
Q: How long did it take to build Hoover? A: About five years, finishing in 1936, two years ahead of schedule.
Q: Why is the Grand Ethiopian Renaissance project so controversial? A: Egypt and Sudan worry it will reduce the Nile's flow downstream.
Visiting a hydroelectric site? Bring ID; many have security checks before you can walk across the crest.
Driving to Grand Coulee in summer? Stay for the evening laser light show projected onto the spillway.
Teton Dam Collapses in Idaho. Floodwaters swept through towns downstream after the new earthen wall failed in June 1976.
Itaipu Sets New Power Record. The Brazil-Paraguay plant on the Paraná supplied most of Paraguay's electricity.
We drove across the top of Hoover and my sister put one foot in Nevada and one in Arizona, right on the line.
My grandad helped pour concrete at the Kariba project in the fifties; he said it was hot enough to cook eggs on the forms.
Trivia: Which concrete arch on the Colorado River was completed in 1936? Answer: Hoover Dam.
Trivia: Which structure across the Yangtze is the world's largest power station? Answer: Three Gorges Dam.
Hey Raj, Contra Dam in Switzerland is where they filmed the GoldenEye bungee jump. You can do it too!
Hi Bea, we toured Aswan High Dam in Egypt. The reservoir behind it goes on forever.
Completed in 1970, the Aswan High Dam ended the Nile's annual floods; this model shows its rock-fill core.
This hard hat belonged to a 'high scaler' who dangled from ropes to clear canyon walls before the Boulder project began.
Water levels behind Hoover have dropped so low that the intake towers are showing a white bathtub ring of mineral stains.
Live from the reservoir: crews will open the spillway gates tomorrow, so stay off the river below.

topic:Cave.text: Mammoth Cave tour starts at 10! Bring a sweater, it's 12 degrees down there all year
Just did the boat ride through the Puerto Princesa underground river, so many bats!!
The National Park Service announced that the Carlsbad Caverns elevator has been repaired and the Big Room trail is open again.
Explorers confirmed today that Hang Son Doong in Vietnam contains a jungle and clouds inside its main chamber.
Q: How was Lascaux discovered? A: In 1940, four teenagers followed their dog into a hole and found walls covered in painted animals.
Q: What's the deepest known shaft in the world? A: Veryovkina, in Abkhazia, over 2,200 meters deep.
On a guided tour underground, don't touch the formations; oils from your skin stop stalactites growing.
For wild caving, always tell someone where you're going and carry three light sources.
Thai Boys Rescued From Tham Luang. All twelve players and their coach were brought out by divers after 18 days.
New Chamber Found in Mammoth Cave System. Surveyors added another 13 kilometers to the world's longest known underground network.
We squeezed through a passage in Waitomo so tight I had to exhale to fit, then the ceiling lit up with glowworms.
As a kid I got lost for ten minutes in Luray Caverns and found the stalactite organ by myself. Scared and amazed.
Trivia: Which French grotto holds 17,000-year-old paintings of horses and bulls? Answer: Lascaux.
Trivia: Which Kentucky system is the longest known in the world? Answer: Mammoth Cave.
Hey Kai, the Blue Grotto on Capri was magical, the light makes the water glow neon blue.
Hi Ana, Eisriesenwelt in Austria is full of ice even in summer. Bring gloves!
Discovered in 1994, Chauvet contains some of the oldest known cave art, more than 30,000 years old.
This stalagmite cross-section from Jenolan in Australia shows growth bands spanning 40,000 years.
Today on Outdoor Radio: spelunkers in Missouri just mapped a new passage under Meramec State Park.
Rescue update: the caver trapped in the flooded tunnel has been reached by divers and is in good spirits.

topic:Glacier.text: Standing on the Perito Moreno walkway, a chunk just broke off and crashed into the water!!
Glacier hike on Fox tomorrow, crampons provided, meet at the hut at 8
Swiss researchers announced that the Rhône Glacier lost another 2 percent of its volume this summer.
Parks Canada confirmed that the Athabasca Glacier walking trail will be rerouted as the ice retreats.
Q: How fast does Jakobshavn move? A: In summer, up to 40 meters a day, among the fastest in the world.
Q: Why are the Aletsch ice fields important? A: They're the largest in the Alps and supply water to the Rhône valley.
Never walk onto an ice tongue without a guide; crevasses can be hidden under snow bridges.
Bring sunglasses on the ice, the glare can burn your eyes even on cloudy days.
Okjökull Declared Dead. Iceland unveils a plaque for the first ice mass lost to climate change.
Thwaites Retreat Accelerates. Scientists say the Antarctic 'Doomsday' ice sheet is melting faster than expected.
I touched the snout of Franz Josef in 1998, and when I went back in 2018 it was a half-hour walk further up the valley.
We kayaked to the face of Hubbard in Alaska and heard it groan like thunder before calving.
Trivia: Which Argentine ice field is famous for advancing rather than retreating? Answer: Perito Moreno.
Trivia: Which is the largest glacier in the Alps? Answer: The Great Aletsch.
Hey Mia, the Mendenhall in Juneau has ice caves under it this year, blue like a cathedral.
Hi Tom, flew over the Vatnajökull ice cap in Iceland. Felt like another planet.
This core from the Quelccaya ice cap in Peru records 1,800 years of climate in its layers.
Photographs of Muir Glacier from 1941 and 2004 show the ice gone, replaced by open water and forest.
Tonight on Planet Watch: the Swiss town that wraps its ice in blankets every summer to slow the melt.
Callers asked about the Columbia Glacier; it's retreated nearly 20 kilometers since 1980.

topic:Mountain.text: Summit of Ben Nevis! Cloud cleared for two minutes, totally worth the climb
Kilimanjaro day 5, leaving for Uhuru Peak at midnight. Wish me luck
Nepal announced today a new permit fee for climbers attempting Everest, rising to $15,000 per person.
Rangers at Denali National Park confirmed that the climbing season saw a record 60 percent summit rate.
Q: Why is K2 called the Savage Mountain? A: It's steeper than Everest and the weather is unpredictable; about one in four climbers have died.
Q: How did you prepare for the Matterhorn? A: Lots of scrambling in the Dolomites and practice with fixed ropes.
Start a big peak hike early; afternoon thunderstorms are common above the treeline in summer.
On Mount Washington, pack layers; the summit has some of the worst weather recorded anywhere.
Nepali Sherpa Sets Everest Record. Kami Rita reached the top of the world's highest peak for the 30th time.
Climbers Summit Annapurna in Winter. The team endured wind chill below minus 50 degrees.
We hiked Mount Fuji overnight to see the sunrise from the top. I've never been so cold or so happy.
My grandmother climbed Snowdon at 80, slowly, refusing the train. She had tea at the summit café.
Trivia: What is the highest peak in Africa? Answer: Kilimanjaro.
Trivia: Which summit in Ecuador is farthest from the Earth's center? Answer: Chimborazo.
Hey Jack, I signed us up for Mount Rainier with a guide in July. Glacier training first day.
Hi Freya, Table Mountain cable car was closed for wind, so we hiked Platteklip Gorge. Brutal but beautiful.
Mont Blanc was first climbed in 1786 by Jacques Balmat and Michel-Gabriel Paccard.
This ice axe was carried by Edmund Hillary on the 1953 first ascent of Everest.
Weekend outdoors: wind gusts of 80 km/h on Grouse Mountain, so skip the summit trail.
Breaking news: helicopter rescue on Mount Hood, two climbers stranded below the Hogsback.

topic:MountainPass.text: Stelvio's 48 hairpins done on the bike!! My legs are toast
Highway closed at Donner Pass, chains required. Taking the long way
The Swiss canton of Uri announced that the Gotthard Pass road will reopen on June 1 after winter snow clearing.
Caltrans confirmed today that Tioga Pass into Yosemite is open for the season.
Q: Why is the Khyber Pass historic? A: It's linked Central Asia and India for millennia; armies from Alexander to the British crossed it.
Q: What's the hardest part of the Tour's climb over the Col du Tourmalet? A: The last four kilometers, steep and in thin air.
Check the Furka road status before driving; high Alpine crossings often close until late May.
On Independence Pass in Colorado, oversized vehicles are banned; stick to the main route.
Hannibal's Route Over the Alps Still Debated. Scientists point to the Col de la Traversette based on ancient dung.
Avalanche Closes Rogers Pass. The Trans-Canada Highway shut for 24 hours in British Columbia.
We drove Transfăgărășan in Romania and stopped at every switchback for photos. Top Gear called it the best road in the world.
My dad drove us over Hardknott Pass in Cumbria in a Mini, 30 percent gradients, Mum held the dashboard the whole time.
Trivia: Which Alpine crossing did Napoleon take into Italy in 1800? Answer: The Great St Bernard Pass.
Trivia: Which Himalayan crossing claims to be one of the highest motorable roads? Answer: Khardung La.
Hey Ollie, the Grossglockner road opens next week. Let's take the motorbikes.
Hi Ines, crossing Thorong La on the Annapurna circuit was tough, 5,416 meters. Headache but worth it.
Simplon has been a key route between Switzerland and Italy since Roman times; Napoleon built the road.
This milestone stood beside Brenner, the lowest major crossing of the Alps, used by Romans.
Traffic alert: snow on Snoqualmie Pass, Interstate 90 eastbound has chain requirements.
Cycling commentary: he's alone at the summit of Galibier, three minutes ahead!

topic:MountainRange.text: Driving through the Rockies, snow on every peak, stopping in Banff tonight
Flying over the Andes right now, look at all those white ridges
Pakistan's tourism board announced new permits for trekkers crossing the Karakoram, home to K2 and three other 8,000-meter peaks.
Officials announced that the Appalachian Trail will add a 30-mile reroute through the Great Smokies section.
Q: Why are the Alps so popular for skiing? A: Reliable snow, villages at high altitude and lifts linking whole valleys.
Q: How old are the Appalachians? A: About 480 million years; they were once as tall as the Himalayas.
Hiking the Pyrenees in summer? Refuges fill fast, so book beds ahead on the GR10.
In the Scottish Highlands, check the forecast; the Cairngorms get Arctic weather even in June.
Himalayas Rising Faster Than Thought. GPS data shows the chain grows about 1 cm per year.
Wildfires Spread Across the Sierra Nevada. Thousands evacuated as flames move through the foothills.
Crossing the Atlas on a bus in Morocco, the driver played music the whole way and we stopped for mint tea at the top.
I spent a summer in the Carpathians with shepherds; we slept in huts and ate cheese for every meal.
Trivia: What is the longest continental chain of peaks in the world? Answer: The Andes.
Trivia: Which range traditionally separates Europe from Asia? Answer: The Urals.
Hey Eva, the Dolomites in October were stunning, the peaks turned pink at sunset.
Hi Bilal, the Hindu Kush trek is on. Our guide says the passes open in mid-June.
The Alps formed when the African plate pushed into Europe, folding sediment into peaks.
This map from 1856 shows the first survey of the Himalayas and the peak later named Everest.
Weather: heavy snow in the Cascades, chain controls on all routes over the crest.
Today on Nature Radio: why the Great Dividing Range shapes rainfall across eastern Australia.

topic:Volcano.text: Etna's erupting!! You can see the lava glow from our hotel balcony in Catania
Flights cancelled, ash cloud from Iceland again. Stuck in Oslo
The USGS raised the alert level for Kīlauea after new fissures opened on the summit.
Indonesian authorities announced evacuations near Mount Merapi as lava domes grew.
Q: How did Vesuvius bury Pompeii? A: In AD 79, pumice and pyroclastic flows covered the town in hours.
Q: Why is Yellowstone called a supervolcano? A: It's had three massive eruptions, the last 640,000 years ago.
Hiking near an active crater? Carry a gas mask; sulfur fumes can be dangerous.
On Stromboli tours, wear sturdy boots and bring a headlamp for the night descent.
Eyjafjallajökull Grounds Flights Across Europe. Ash from Iceland halted air traffic for six days in 2010.
Hunga Tonga Blast Heard in Alaska. The undersea eruption sent a pressure wave around the globe.
We stood on the rim of Masaya in Nicaragua and looked down at bubbling lava. My face was hot.
My uncle was a ranger at Mount St. Helens; he said ash fell like gray snow for days.
Trivia: Which Mexican peak appeared in a farmer's cornfield in 1943? Answer: Parícutin.
Trivia: Which 1883 eruption in Indonesia was heard 4,800 km away? Answer: Krakatoa.
Hey Nina, Mauna Loa's lava flow is visible from the highway at night. Let's drive out.
Hi Pablo, we climbed Villarrica in Chile and looked into the lava lake. Unreal.
Tambora's 1815 eruption caused the 'Year Without a Summer' across Europe and North America.
This cast shows a dog from Pompeii, trapped by the eruption of Vesuvius.
Breaking: lava from Fagradalsfjall has reached the road near Grindavík, residents evacuated.
Science hour: what's happening under Campi Flegrei, the restless caldera near Naples.

topic:Racecourse.text: Royal Ascot tomorrow! Hats on, gates open at 10:30
Cheltenham Festival, Gold Cup day, I've got a fiver on the Irish horse
Churchill Downs announced a new paddock and grandstand ahead of the 150th Kentucky Derby.
The Hong Kong Jockey Club confirmed that Happy Valley will host its first international night meeting this season.
Q: Why is Aintree's Grand National so famous? A: The fences are huge, like Becher's Brook, and the race is over four miles.
Q: What makes Flemington special? A: The Melbourne Cup, and roses lining the whole straight.
Going to the races? Arrive early to see the horses parade; you can judge their mood before betting.
At Saratoga, pack a picnic; you can bring food to the backyard area.
Rich Strike Wins Kentucky Derby at 80-1. The longshot surged along the rail at Churchill Downs.
Longchamp Reopens After Renovation. Paris's track unveiled a new grandstand for the Arc.
We went to Del Mar on opening day and everyone wore crazy hats; my friend's had a working fountain.
My dad took me to Epsom on Derby Day when I was ten; I picked the grey horse and it won.
Trivia: Which track hosts the Kentucky Derby? Answer: Churchill Downs.
Trivia: Which Melbourne venue holds the 'race that stops a nation'? Answer: Flemington.
Hey Sean, Leopardstown at Christmas is brilliant. Mulled wine and steeplechases.
Hi Ruth, Meydan in Dubai hosts the World Cup night. The grandstand is a mile long!
Newmarket has hosted horse racing since the 1600s; Charles II often rode here.
These silks were worn at Longchamp by the jockey of the first Arc de Triomphe winner, 1920.
And they're off at Belmont Park! Three furlongs to go, the favorite has the lead!
Live from Goodwood, where the track's famous slope has caught out another favorite!

topic:Bridge.text: Walking the Golden Gate right now, the fog is rolling in under the deck, so cool
Traffic on the Verrazzano is terrible, take the ferry instead
Transport officials announced that the Brooklyn Bridge promenade will get a new bike lane.
Scotland's transport agency confirmed the Queensferry Crossing over the Firth of Forth carried a record 30 million vehicles last year.
Q: How long did the Golden Gate take to build? A: About four years, opening in 1937.
Q: Why does the Tower Bridge open? A: Its bascules lift for tall ships heading upriver.
